query:
SELECT
            ci.product_id,
            ci.quantity,
            p.name            AS product_name,
            p.price_per_unit,
            s.id              AS stock_id,
            s.quantity_available - s.quantity_reserved
                              AS "free_quantity!: Decimal"
        FROM cart_items ci
        JOIN products p ON p.id = ci.product_id
        JOIN stock    s ON s.product_id = ci.product_id
        WHERE ci.cart_id = $1
